description: This file contains functions for inspecting network port usage across different operating systems, including parsing command outputs, resolving process info, and checking port availability.

methods.name: runCommandSafe
methods.description: Executes a command with a timeout, returning a CommandResult object, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: parseLsofFieldOutput
methods.description: Parses output from lsof command to extract port listener information.

methods.name: enrichUnixListenerProcessInfo
methods.description: Enriches listener info with process command line, user, and parent PID by querying system processes.

methods.name: resolveUnixCommandLine
methods.description: Resolves the command line of a process given its PID on Unix systems.

methods.name: resolveUnixUser
methods.description: Resolves the user owning a process given its PID on Unix systems.

methods.name: resolveUnixParentPid
methods.description: Resolves the parent PID of a process given its PID on Unix systems.

methods.name: parseSsListeners
methods.description: Parses ss command output to identify listening sockets on Unix systems.

methods.name: readUnixListenersFromSs
methods.description: Reads listening sockets info using ss command on Unix systems.

methods.name: readUnixListeners
methods.description: Reads listening sockets info using lsof or ss fallback on Unix systems.

methods.name: parseNetstatListeners
methods.description: Parses netstat command output to identify listening sockets on Windows systems.

methods.name: resolveWindowsImageName
methods.description: Resolves the image name of a process given its PID on Windows.

methods.name: resolveWindowsCommandLine
methods.description: Resolves the command line of a process given its PID on Windows.

methods.name: readWindowsListeners
methods.description: Reads listening port info on Windows using netstat and resolves process details.

methods.name: tryListenOnHost
methods.description: Attempts to listen on a port for a specific host, returning status.

methods.name: checkPortInUse
methods.description: Checks if a port is in use across common local addresses.

methods.name: inspectPortUsage
methods.description: Main exported function to inspect port usage, combining system-specific checks and returning port status, listeners, hints, and errors.
